poetryFrame.leftVertical: WE LAY OUR HEARTS OUT ON THE TABLE, A RISKY GAMBLE OF GOLD AND FLAME.
poetryFrame.rightVertical: YOUR LIGHT CATCHES US WHEN WE ARE MOST VULNERABLE TO BEGIN AGAIN.
poetryFrame.bottomLine: LOST IN THE FIRELIGHT, STUMBLING BEYOND ALL CONTROL
sonnetLines: The reckless rhythm of the heart,
A flame that catches in the dark.
We fall together, blind and free,
Old freedoms fade like morning mist,
Through shadowed rooms where whispers gleam,
A waking truth within a dream.
The fragile light of one embrace,
Rewrites the map upon this place.
We stumble onward, breath by slow breath,
